title: ECI Software Solutions Appoints Ron Books CEO as Trevor Gruenewald Retires | citybiz
content:
ECI did not disclose financial terms associated with the executive transition or announce changes to its ownership structure.

With Books scheduled to assume the CEO position on October 26, the company will enter its next phase of development under a returning leader as it continues expanding AI-enabled and cloud-based software capabilities for small and mid-sized businesses worldwide.

Under Books’ leadership, ECI plans to continue its existing strategy, with particular emphasis on AI-powered software and cloud-based business applications.

The company did not announce major changes to its product portfolio or investment priorities alongside the leadership transition. [...] Books said he intends to maintain the company’s strategic direction while continuing to invest in technologies that support customer operations.

“ECI has been an important part of my life for nearly three decades, and I couldn’t be more excited to return as CEO,” Books said.

“I know this company, its customers and its people deeply, and my focus will be on building on that momentum as we continue investing in the technology that helps our customers run better businesses.”

title: ECI Software Solutions Announces CEO Transition | Hardware Retailing
content:
As CEO, Books will continue to advance ECI’s existing strategy and investment priorities, including its focus on delivering AI-powered, cloud-based software that gives small and mid-sized businesses the technology they need to compete with far larger rivals. Gruenewald will remain actively involved in ECI’s strategic direction as a board member and will work closely with Books and the leadership team throughout the transition.

Share [...] “It has been a privilege to partner with Trevor, who built ECI into a global leader in mission-critical software for small and mid-sized businesses. We thank him for his leadership and are pleased he will continue to guide ECI as a board member,” says Usama Cortas, ECI board member and partner at Leonard Green & Partners, L.P. “We are equally excited to welcome Ron back as CEO. Ron led ECI through its formative years and knows its customers, people and markets deeply.
